response_texts: Uncle Brandt, are you going out today, too? Where are you going? I want to go with you...
Just for a bit. And you should stay at home, Lalanoah. It's just a little errand.
Uncle Brandt, you've been keeping secrets lately! It's suspicious and I'm going with you!
No true Nord keeps secrets! I'm just going on a bounty hunt!
Well, then I will go with you. Should I beat up your bounty?
No, of course not. You can't even fight, can you?
I can swing a sword! I've learned from mom and dad!
...Really? But today's dessert is apple pie. And if you play with the bounty you won't be able to eat your dessert.
Well, um... what should I...
Have a safe trip, uncle Brandt!
Looks like the cat has fulfilled its role. Even if he was only an imitation, his power was real.
Now, come here. Even though you are a mortal, you are an important tool. Let me show you the respect you deserve.
Fate is now set on this path.
No one can impede our steps anymore.
Yes, the plan is fine, boss. No one's aware of our plans.
Yes, it is. We mix it in with the iron daggers. The guards are tired and don't even check the contents of shipments.
I have a little problem, though... The blacksmiths put a price on my head. Could you put some pressure on them to withdraw it?
Yes, yes, right. Thank you very much. Glory to the Thalmor!
This is so dirty... Don't touch me with those green hands of yours!
That Radcliffe bastard... I told him over and over not to be stingy over the escort. He was so stupid...
Well, Orlando is there... What comes next? ...Oh?
...Oh, looks like I'm in trouble. I had no idea it was still so powerful.
Perhaps it would be enough to simply banish and contain it? Well then, let's just indulge in some writing until the time is right.
Now, how shall we start? Perhaps with an encounter between a puppet and a patsy, and then paint an image of ordinary, unassuming life. Repetition is important, after all.
Then continue with a Chick Trader and hunting witches, though the latter may be a bit... No, let's do this. It's a bit aggressive, but it won't hurt the plan.
Our interference must be minimal and yet cause a situation with no choice. The rest will follow... Otherwise, we will not be able to see the Blue Star.
Fair is foul, and foul is fair. And so, I will be the kind one. Enjoy!
The cheese... It's returning to the Mother Sea. How touching, it's making me cry like a sea turtle!
Oh don't cry, handsome. I'm sure that cheese will grow big and strong and return from the ocean one day. And then...
Then this beach will become a spawning ground for the adult cheese, right? Like a dream come true!
All the wild cheese, free for the taking. But I'm worried about the blue birds. They may steal the cheese eggs.
Ah, being overprotective gives the cheese bad flavor. Only the cheese that survives makes for the good cheese.
Indeed, I'm already looking forward to four hundred years from now. Come on, let's go home.
Ah yes, let's go home. Patience is cheese.
If I could have abandoned my mission and followed Her to the very end, perhaps I could have found peace...
But I could not do that and so, my Prince erased me from Mundus. Even so, I wanted to honor Her legacy...
I wanted to preserve the Gold Road that She once walked...
The heart stone is already prepared. All you must do is fire it, yes?
Here we go. You are on your own now. It begins.
Let the successor be saved... Let the great usurper be cursed... I will avenge them... with Kyne's wrath...
My Lord, you have spoken. Words are fire, and change and struggle are the root of all things...
You were already good and righteous! And now, I have received the fire of your hope!
You who are cursed by blood, leave this place. There is nothing for you here.
You mortals are fragile. And yet, only you can transcend the framework of creation and reach the spirit of Ada.
Numancia lies beyond violence. Just as the Ayleids once found Radiance in human suffering and viscera...
Thus I shall follow their example, and inflict pain upon you once more.
The mortal actually ate it... Why did they think they could eat that? Are they insane?
Oh, come now. They're still just a baby. They must have wanted to put something in their mouth.
Wouldn't a baby prefer milk over cheese? But I don't have any milk!
I'm sure Haskill would be kind enough to provide some milk for the mortal. He's such a good servant.
What a great idea, pussy cat! Let's go home and come up with the next cheese plan, shall we?
Now, let's go seek cheese in infinity and beyond!
Romion, we have a new mission. We must investigate the source of the ghouls. Make preparations.
All right, Ozwald. Is there anything in particular you will need?
Our opponents are ghouls... We'll need antidotes for two people.
Understood. I'll prepare everything.
Hup! This staff feels lighter than before. Maybe because I grew up?
I'm ready to go home. Let's go.
I'm happy my mom's staff is back. Now that we know where mom is, I'll be able to see her soon, right? I can't wait!
Mom said she'd give me this staff when I become a healer. So I'll study hard and surprise her when she returns!
This staff is amazing. It turns people good when you hit them with it. Before mommy met daddy, she used it to beat up bandits in the hold.
Mom beat up uncle Brandt with this staff, too! But he probably doesn't remember because he was so drunk at the time.
I always walked down that path with mom and dad, and Skoll, too. It's only been a short time ago, but it feels so much longer.
Something calls me back, but... well, I'm still hoping. When they come back, we'll walk there again.
A blood curse is wandering in the forest. So be careful. You are no longer pure...
That's it. A treasure fell from the flying ship. When Grolly put it on, she could speak properly.
From the sky... Something similar happened to me. But it wasn't a treasure. They were monsters.
Really? What happened then? Did you defeat them?
Oh yes, I defeated them all, with the help of my friend. It was easy.
Awesome! If I train, can I become as strong as you or your friend?
Oh? Well, maybe. But didn't you say you wanted to be a healer?
Well, then I'll be a super-strong healer! I'll beat them to a pulp and then I'll heal them again!
By Shor, you're scaring me, kid...
All right, you are free to go now.
Are you all right, Lalanoah? Are you injured?
No... I'm fine.
Are you in pain? You must have been so scared!
I am fine... I am strong...
Well, then, do not mind this one. Have a nice day.
